newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds end at record low.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds end at record low.

text.p: 1656 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended lower in line with foreign markets on profit taking, but did not keep track with the fall of Bunds as yield spreads against 10-year Bunds dropped to a record low of 49 basis points, dealers said.
*Spread vs 10-yr Bunds 49 bp vs 59 bp cls
Portuguese bonds closed lower in line with foreign markets as yield spreads against 10-year Bunds dropped to a record low of around 50 basis points, dealers said.
Considering the lack of paper and the tight spreads, current price levels appeared vulnerable, they said.
"Germany slid and the negative impact was felt by peripheral markets. Portuguese futures closed lower, and the cash market took profits," a fixed income analyst said.
